title: Montreal Supper Club by Michelin-Trained Chef
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A singular culinary experience, Edible Other is a Supper Club dedicated to exploring the global, French-tinged flavours that make Montreal food culture so special. Each dish is personally cooked and narrated by a Michelin-trained Chef, telling the story of Quebec as inspired by its rich immigrant communities. No more than 15 diners in any seating unless a private or corporate booking. Diners can also enjoy historic 1800's architecture in the kitchen loft space. All food allergies, religious needs, and dislikes are accommodated.
